standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Numbers computed from run 2026-10-18T144903Z, recomputed 2026-10-18 after the observation record's 2026-10-01 pass was recovered. The BLS PPI and CPI series carry September 2026. Prose drafted 2026-10-18 by a session, from numbers.md, at the editor's instruction; tools/check.py passes, 75 figures, so no figure in the text is absent from numbers.json. Awaiting the editor's read and reviewer line before publication. Two corrections are recorded here because they changed the computed set. First, the 2026-10-01 observation pass had captured all eight sellers and the record carried rows for one: a seller behind a bot check served an HTML captcha with a 200 to its product endpoint, the parser called json.loads on it, and the resulting JSONDecodeError was not a ParseFailure, so it ended the pass instead of failing that source, costing the six sellers after it in source order. lobster/observations/tools/parse.py now fails a source rather than the pass, and the retained captures were re-parsed. The month now holds both capture dates and the 2026-10-01 outcome of every seller is explicit in data/flags.jsonl: two parsed, two PARSE_FAILED, four FAILED_CAPTURE from one HTTP 403 and three HTTP 429. Those four were lost at capture, are not recoverable from the retained response, and their products are marked unavailable for that date rather than omitted. Second, issue.py built its series map from the named run alone, so a source stating one period per report could carry no comparison; that is corrected and named in PROVENANCE.md, and it does not affect this title, whose sources all carry their own history. Remaining gaps: of the eight sellers observed, two carry the reference series of a single live hard-shell 1.25 lb lobster, so the consumer reference rests on sellers D and G. Seller G is observed on both capture dates and did not move; seller D is observed on 2026-10-15 only. The consumer reference carries no year-over-year comparison: the Field Assembly observation record begins 2026-09-26. The NOAA import figures are for 2026-08, the newest month that series publishes, and the record holds no 2024-08 reading, so neither import measure carries a two-year comparison. The Maine DMR September ex-vessel figure is 2025 and preliminary. Month-to-month movement is not in this issue's computed set. The USDA ERS Food Price Outlook year-over-year attribute is August 2025 to August 2026, not September.
